summary: Iteration 21 - Comprehensive testing of Orange Pharmacy Loyalty Program and related features. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working including Loyalty Banner, Dialog with Overview/FAQ/Terms tabs, and Evara 3x2 Quick Actions grid.
test_type: Orange Pharmacy Loyalty Program - Final Testing

test_categories.details: Returns bronze, silver, gold tiers with correct benefits
Gold (1200=10% discount), Silver (600=5% discount), Bronze (300=0%), Diagnostic 2x points

tests.name: Pharmacy page loads with Orange Pharmacy logo
Loyalty Program Banner visible on /pharmacy page
Loyalty Banner shows correct text (Bronze | Silver | Gold tiers)
Loyalty Dialog opens on banner click
Loyalty Dialog has Overview tab with tier cards
Loyalty Dialog has FAQ tab with 10 questions
Loyalty Dialog has Terms tab with T&C sections
Evara Quick Actions shows 3x2 grid layout on desktop

pharmacy_loyalty_tiers.details: GET /api/pharmacy/loyalty/tiers returns bronze (0+), silver (500+, 5% discount), gold (1000+, 10% discount, 10-visit reward)

pharmacy_loyalty_faq.details: GET /api/pharmacy/loyalty/faq returns 10 FAQs covering joining, tiers, points, redemption, Gold reward, expiry, transfers, balance check, returns, exclusions

pharmacy_loyalty_terms.details: GET /api/pharmacy/loyalty/terms-and-conditions returns 12 sections: Program Overview, Eligibility, Tier Benefits, Loyalty Points, Gold 10-Visit Reward, Redemption, Program Changes, Account Termination, Privacy, Limitation of Liability, Governing Law, Contact Information

pharmacy_loyalty_calculate_benefits.details: GET /api/pharmacy/loyalty/calculate-benefits correctly calculates tier, discount, points. Amount 1200 = Gold (10% = ₹120 discount). Amount 600 = Silver (5% = ₹30 discount). Diagnostic orders get 2x points.

loyalty_banner_frontend.details: Orange gradient banner visible on /pharmacy page with Crown icon, 'Orange Pharmacy Loyalty Program' title, and tier info

loyalty_dialog_frontend.details: Dialog opens with 3 tabs: Overview (tier cards with benefits), FAQ (10 Q&A), Terms (12 sections). All tabs functional and scrollable.

billing_summary_api.details: GET /api/billing/summary returns total_invoices, total_billed, total_collected, total_due, collection_rate, status_counts, service_counts, overdue info

reminders_pending_api.details: GET /api/reminders/pending returns today and tomorrow reminders with proper structure

community_categories_api.details: GET /api/community/categories returns 7 categories: pregnancy, fertility, menopause, pcos, nutrition, mental_health, general

evara_quick_actions_grid.details: Evara page shows 3x2 grid layout on desktop: Row 1 (Chat with Evara, Pregnancy Calc, Reminders), Row 2 (Period Tracker, Calorie Tracker, Week-by-Week)

critical_code_review_comments: All Orange Pharmacy Loyalty Program features implemented correctly
Tier calculation logic working: Bronze (any), Silver (500+), Gold (1000+)
FAQ has comprehensive 10 questions covering all user concerns
Terms & Conditions has 12 detailed sections for legal compliance
Frontend Loyalty Banner and Dialog well-designed with proper tabs
Evara Quick Actions grid layout correct (3x2 on desktop)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 verified all Orange Pharmacy Loyalty Program features: 3 tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold), 10 FAQs, 12 T&C sections, calculate-benefits API with correct tier/discount logic, frontend banner and dialog with Overview/FAQ/Terms tabs. Also verified Billing Summary, Reminders Pending, Community Categories APIs, and Evara 3x2 Quick Actions grid. All tests passing. Test file: /app/tests/test_iteration_21_loyalty_program.py
